questions.text: For the gradient boosted model, what is the AUC (and average precision) under random stratified 5-fold CV versus spatial block CV at the reference block size, each with its spread over 5 repetitions, and what is the difference?

Under spatial block CV at the reference block size, does either model rank held-out gold-producer cells better than chance (mean AUC at least 0.60 and minimum over repetitions above 0.55), and what fraction of held-out positives fall in the top 5 and top 10 percent of cells?
Is the analytical batch learnable: how does AUC change when the method family is left out entirely (leave-one-family-out), and when it is added as a covariate (exploratory)?
Which elements carry the signal in the held-out predictions, and are they plausible gold pathfinders or lithological proxies? (exploratory)
